en: A black‑and‑white view of a tree‑lined boulevard with a single pedestrian walking away from the camera. At the entrance to the avenue stand two large stone plinths, each surmounted by a reclining lion sculpture. Behind the right plinth is a villa-like building with a square tower, shuttered windows and a weathervane. The scene appears early‑20th‑century, with no cars present and a simple wooden fence running along the right side. The overall composition and framing resemble a vintage architectural postcard.
